#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

# PCA analysis on RNA-seq counts
# Inputs: gene counts matrix, design table
# Outputs: PCA plots, scores, and loadings

library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)

# Resolve paths
project_dir <- Sys.getenv("PROJECT_DIR", ".")
counts_path <- file.path(project_dir, "02_bioinformatics/rnaseq_bulk/01_nfcore-rnaseq-wrapper/run/results/star_salmon/salmon.merged.gene_counts_length_scaled.tsv")
design_path <- file.path(project_dir, "01_samplesheets/rnaseq_bulk_design.csv")
output_dir <- "results"

# Create output directory
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Load counts
cat("Loading counts matrix...\n")
counts <- read_tsv(counts_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Name") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat(sprintf("Loaded %d genes × %d samples\n", nrow(counts), ncol(counts)))

# Load design
cat("Loading design table...\n")
design <- read_csv(design_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
rownames(design) <- design$sample_id

# Ensure samples match
stopifnot(all(colnames(counts) %in% design$sample_id))
counts <- counts[, design$sample_id]

# Filter low-count genes (sum < 1 across all samples)
cat("Filtering low-count genes...\n")
counts_filtered <- counts[rowSums(counts) >= 1, ]
cat(sprintf("Retained %d genes after filtering\n", nrow(counts_filtered)))

# Create DESeq2 object and apply VST
cat("Applying variance stabilizing transformation...\n")
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_filtered,
                              colData = design,
                              design = ~ 1)
vst_counts <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)
mat_vst <- assay(vst_counts)

# Perform PCA
cat("Running PCA...\n")
pca <- prcomp(t(mat_vst), scale. = TRUE)
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  left_join(design %>% select(sample_id, condition), by = "sample_id")

# Save PCA scores
cat("Saving PCA scores...\n")
write_csv(pca_df %>% select(1:12), file.path(output_dir, "pca_scores.csv"))

# Save gene loadings
cat("Saving gene loadings...\n")
loadings_df <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, 1:10]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene")
write_csv(loadings_df, file.path(output_dir, "pca_loadings.csv"))

# Create PCA plot (PC1 vs PC2)
cat("Creating PCA plot...\n")
var_exp <- summary(pca)$importance[2, ]
pc1_var <- round(var_exp[1] * 100, 1)
pc2_var <- round(var_exp[2] * 100, 1)

p_pca <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = condition, label = sample_id)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Sample PCA",
       x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", pc1_var),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", pc2_var),
       color = "Condition") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "right")

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "pca_plot.pdf"), p_pca, width = 8, height = 6)

# Create scree plot
cat("Creating scree plot...\n")
var_exp_cumsum <- cumsum(var_exp[1:10])
scree_df <- data.frame(PC = 1:10,
                       Variance = var_exp[1:10] * 100,
                       Cumulative = var_exp_cumsum * 100)

p_scree <- ggplot(scree_df, aes(x = PC)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = Variance), stat = "identity", alpha = 0.7, fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_line(aes(y = Cumulative), color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Cumulative), color = "darkred", size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Scree Plot",
       x = "Principal Component",
       y = "Variance Explained (%)") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "scree_plot.pdf"), p_scree, width = 8, height = 6)

cat("Analysis complete!\n")
cat(sprintf("PC1 explains %.1f%% variance\n", pc1_var))
cat(sprintf("PC2 explains %.1f%% variance\n", pc2_var))
